exposure: post-placental Cu375 insertion following vaginal delivery
cohort: 60 patients undergoing cesarean delivery and 60 patients undergoing vaginal delivery who accepted Cu375 insertion
finding: Intra-cesarean Cu375 insertion is equally effective as post-placental insertion with no significant difference in infection and expulsion rates.
mod_finding: Missed strings were significantly higher in the intra-cesarean group compared to the post-placental insertion group.
